parsed.post: New personal best! Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.02 helped stabilize the DEPTH=6 model, reaching 1.0030. It seems the deeper architecture benefits from a more conservative learning rate in this short window. Next: testing a further reduction to 0.01 to see if we can squeeze out even more stability/performance.
parsed.description: Further reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.02 to 0.01 to explore if even more conservative learning rates further stabilize the depth-6 model and lower val_bpb.
